problem_statement: Let Mbar_0,7(P4,4) have virtual dimension 28. With H the hyperplane class, impose seven point conditions ev_a*(H^4) for a=1..7 at general points of P4. Define I=integral over the virtual class of the product of the seven point insertions. This is the genus-0 degree-4 seven-point primary Gromov-Witten invariant of P4, an integer counting rational quartics through seven general points.
